title: Queue claim
description: One claimed ticket in state/queue.json. Written by ticket-intake, updated by each downstream stage.

repo.description: Repo the ticket lives in. Always example-org/example-app-core (team issues are filed there regardless of which repo the work touches).

impl_repo.description: Repo the branch, commits, and PR land in — routed from the ticket's repo:<name> label. Often differs from `repo`: an SDK ticket is filed in example-app-core but implemented in example-app-sdk-py/js/go. One claim per (issue, impl_repo) pair, so a three-SDK ticket fans out to three claims.

ticket_class.description: Autonomy-ladder class, e.g. sdk-regen, docs, test-scaffolding, service-feature

status.description: spec-clarify-pending = parked on one clarifying question posted to the ticket; holds no WIP slot; resumes when a human re-dispatches spec-draft

spec_fast_path.description: True when the spec gate was skipped per the template's does-not-apply list

closed_at.description: When the claim reached merged/abandoned (stamped by update-claim.sh). pr-merged-reap reaps terminal claims older than the retention window by this date, falling back to claimed_at for older records

merge_sha.description: Merge commit on the implementation repo (written by pr-merged-reap on merged)

retry_count.description: Spec-draft attempts against this claim (drain-chain retries on failure or cancellation)

clarify_reason.description: One-line reason from RESULT: CLARIFY_NEEDED — what the drafter could not resolve from the ticket

blocked_by.description: Prerequisite named by RESULT: DEPENDENCY_BLOCKED (issue/PR/ADR ref); claim is abandoned until a human re-queues

blocked_owner.description: GitHub handle from named-people.yaml, or 'unassigned', for whoever owns the blocker in blocked_by

claim_verification.description: claim-verify gate verdict on the spec PR (spec-draft.yml). contradicted = the PR was converted to draft and labeled claims:contradicted; a human resolves before approval

last_review_dispatched.description: id of the most recent human CHANGES_REQUESTED review on the pr-open claim's PR that pr-review-reap.yml has already dispatched a revise.yml round for — prevents re-dispatching every poll for the same standing review
